How it works

Counts only direct recipe ingredients. Intermediate items such as gunpowder are not broken down further or treated as inventory that can be automatically recycled.

Actual output may exceed your target. Shared materials are combined before inventory is subtracted once; calculating does not consume your saved inventory.

Recipes use local data from game version 1.13.11920. Blueprint unlocks, workbench requirements and custom server changes are not included.
